description: Look up metadata for one or more series by numeric series id. Returns label, short_label, description (Portuguese by default), dataset_id, domain_ids, and dimension_category. Use this to identify a series and find which dataset_id holds its observations, then call get_dataset. NOTE: this endpoint returns metadata only — it does NOT return the numeric values. lang defaults to PT.

series_ids.description: One or more numeric series ids, comma-separated, e.g. "8201" or "8201,8202".

name: get_series_metadata
title: Get Series Metadata
